item.title: 雷军同日到访宇树科技与 B 站，分别与王兴兴、陈睿交流
item.guid: 雷军同日到访宇树科技与-B-站，分别与王兴兴、陈睿交流
item.description:
According to reports from "Ke Chuang Ban Daily," Xiaomi founder Lei Jun visited Unitree Robotics on September 14, accompanied by Wang Xingxing, and watched a humanoid robot performance. Public information did not disclose whether the two parties discussed investment, product cooperation, or other specific arrangements. 据《科创板日报》报道，小米创始人雷军 9 月 14 日在王兴兴陪同下探访宇树科技，并观看人形机器人表演。公开信息没有披露双方是否讨论投资、产品合作或其他具体安排。

On the same day, Lei Jun also visited Bilibili's Shanghai headquarters to communicate with Bilibili Chairman Chen Rui. A large screen at the scene displayed the slogan "Welcome Bilibili UP Master Lei Jun." Chen Rui served as Lei Jun's technical assistant when he joined Kingsoft Software in his early years; the specific topics of this visit were also not disclosed. 雷军同日还到访 B 站上海总部，与 B 站董事长陈睿交流。现场大屏打出「欢迎 B 站 UP 主雷军」的标语。陈睿早年加入金山软件时曾担任雷军的技术助理；此次访问的具体议题同样未公开。

item.title: 微信回应「小微」隐私争议：仅按用户指令临时读取指定聊天
item.guid: 微信回应「小微」隐私争议：仅按用户指令临时读取指定聊天
item.description:
On September 15, WeChat employee "Kecun Xiao Jiang" responded to the privacy controversy surrounding the AI assistant "Xiaowei," stating that the information Xiaowei can access will not exceed what the user themselves can view, and claims of "directly reading chat records" and "peeking at all privacy" are untrue. 9 月 15 日，微信员工「客村小蒋」回应 AI 助手「小微」的隐私争议称，小微能接触的信息不会超过用户本人可查看的范围，所谓「直接读取聊天记录」和「偷看所有隐私」的说法不实。

According to the response, Xiaowei will only temporarily read user-specified chat records locally from the WeChat client for analysis and summarization when the user actively initiates "Ask Xiaowei" in a chat scenario; original chat records will not be saved. Content recommendations for official accounts, video accounts, etc., can refer to follow, browse, and interaction data, but are also subject to user permission scope. 按照回应，小微只有在聊天场景中由用户主动发起「问小微」时，才会从微信客户端本地临时读取用户指定的聊天记录，用于分析和总结；原始聊天记录不会保存。公众号、视频号等内容推荐可参考关注、浏览和互动数据，但同样受用户权限范围约束。

Xiaowei was developed by the WeChat team and is currently undergoing limited internal testing. It can query weather, express delivery, and food delivery via text or voice, and can also be invoked in scenarios such as Moments, official accounts, chats, and video accounts. 小微由微信团队开发，目前仍在小范围内测，可通过文字或语音查询天气、快递和外卖，也能在朋友圈、公众号、聊天和视频号等场景被唤起。

item.title: Google 向全体工程师开放 Claude，Gemini 仍是默认模型
item.guid: Google-向全体工程师开放-Claude，Gemini-仍是默认模型
item.description:
According to Business Insider, Google has opened Anthropic's Claude to all its engineers. A Google spokesperson confirmed that engineers can now use the Opus 5 model via the internal development tool Antigravity; previously, only some DeepMind and high-priority teams had access. 据 Business Insider 报道，Google 已向全体工程师开放 Anthropic 的 Claude。Google 发言人确认，工程师现在可以通过内部开发工具 Antigravity 使用 Opus 5 模型；过去只有部分 DeepMind 与高优先级团队拥有相关权限。

Claude has a usage quota per user within the company and is positioned as a supplementary tool, with Gemini remaining the default and primary model. Claude 在公司内部设有每位用户的使用配额，定位是补充工具，Gemini 仍是默认和主要模型。

Google previously generally did not allow most employees to use external AI tools for work. This expansion of access provides engineers with a formal channel to compare the programming performance of different models, and also turns Claude from an exceptional tool used by a few teams into a supplementary option available for all engineers to apply for. Google 此前通常不允许大多数员工在工作中使用外部 AI 工具。这次扩大权限，为工程师比较不同模型的编程表现提供了正式渠道，也让 Claude 从少数团队使用的例外工具变成全体工程师可申请使用的补充选项。

item.title: 黄仁勋活动现场免提接听特朗普电话，双方隔空探讨 AI
item.guid: 黄仁勋活动现场免提接听特朗普电话，双方隔空探讨-AI
item.description:
At the All-in Summit held in Los Angeles on September 14, NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang took a hands-free call from former US President Donald Trump during his speech. 9 月 14 日在洛杉矶举行的 All-in Summit 峰会上，英伟达 CEO 黄仁勋在演讲期间接听了美国总统特朗普打来的免提电话。

During the call, Trump called AI doomsday theories a "hoax," stated that robots could never rule the world, and criticized calls to slow down AI development, deeming such appeals politically motivated. 通话中，特朗普将 AI 末日论称为「骗局」，表示机器人绝不可能统治世界，并批评了放缓 AI 发展速度的主张，认为此类呼吁出于政治动机。

Trump also mentioned his uncle, John G. Trump, who taught at MIT for over forty years, claiming that he himself possesses similar talents due to family genetic inheritance and thus has a deep understanding of AI; Jensen Huang responded on the spot, "No wonder you know so much about AI." 特朗普还提到自己在麻省理工学院任教四十余年的叔叔约翰·乔治·特朗普，称自己凭借家族基因遗传也具备相应天赋，因而深谙 AI 领域； 黄仁勋在现场回应称「难怪你对 AI 这么懂」 。

Separately, according to the Financial Times, Jensen Huang expressed different approaches to AI safety and regulation issues at Salesforce's annual Dreamforce conference. 另据《金融时报》报道，黄仁勋在 Salesforce 年度 Dreamforce 大会上就 AI 安全与监管议题表达了不同路径。

Regarding previous calls by Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei for the industry to slow down the development of new models, and proposals by Elon Musk and OpenAI CEO Sam Altman publicly supporting controlled R&D pace, Jensen Huang stated he does not agree with deceleration as a universal industry solution. 针对此前 Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei 呼吁行业放缓新模型开发速度，以及马斯克和 OpenAI CEO Sam Altman 公开支持控制研发节奏的提议，黄仁勋表示不同意将减速作为行业通用方案。

Jensen Huang defines AI safety as an engineering problem, advocating for pausing handling when a product is out of control, continuing R&D after confirming control, and continuously embedding evaluation and protection into the development process, rather than stopping technological evolution. At the regulatory level, he believes existing laws and market mechanisms are sufficient to constrain product liability, eliminating the need for a separate set of new laws for AI. 黄仁勋将 AI 安全定义为工程问题，主张在产品失控时暂停处置、确认可控后继续研发，将评估和防护持续嵌入开发流程，而非停止技术演进。在监管层面，他认为现有法律和市场机制足以约束产品责任，无需单独为 AI 设立一套新法律。

item.title: 鸿蒙智行确认问界合作模式调整，赛力斯主导五项业务
item.guid: 鸿蒙智行确认问界合作模式调整，赛力斯主导五项业务
item.description:
On September 15, HarmonyOS Smart Travel released an explanation of the AITO cooperation model. Effective immediately, AITO's product definition, product design, brand marketing, channel retail, and service system will be led by Seres, with Huawei Terminal participating in empowerment. 9 月 15 日，鸿蒙智行发布问界合作模式说明。即日起，问界的产品定义、产品设计、品牌营销、渠道零售和服务体系改由赛力斯主导，华为终端参与赋能。

HarmonyOS Smart Travel stated that AITO remains a member of HarmonyOS Smart Travel, and existing user rights and subsequent services will not be affected. This adjustment also does not involve other brands; Luxeed, Stelato, AITO, and Maxtron will continue to adopt a cooperation model led by Huawei throughout the entire process. 鸿蒙智行表示，问界仍是鸿蒙智行成员，现有用户权益及后续服务不受影响。此次调整也不涉及其他品牌，尊界、享界、智界和尚界仍采用华为全流程主导的合作模式。

This statement confirmed earlier reports regarding changes in the cooperation model between the two parties, while limiting the scope of adjustment to AITO and clarifying Huawei's role in the new model. 这份说明确认了当天早些时候有关双方合作模式变化的报道，同时把调整范围限定在问界，并明确了华为在新模式中的角色。

item.title: Disney 要求更多远程产品与技术员工每周到岗四天
item.guid: Disney-要求更多远程产品与技术员工每周到岗四天
item.description:
According to Business Insider, some Disney product and technology employees who previously worked remotely were notified on September 14 that they would now need to work four days a week in the office. 据 Business Insider 报道，Disney 部分原本远程工作的产品与技术员工 9 月 14 日收到通知，今后需要每周到办公室工作四天。

Disney's current company policy already primarily requires four days in the office per week, but implementation varies across different teams, with some employees consistently allowed to work remotely. This notification targets specific positions and is not a new company-wide policy. The company is promoting a "One Disney" collaboration approach, hoping different business teams will use more unified workflows. Disney 现行公司政策本就以每周四天到岗为主，但不同团队的执行存在差异，部分员工一直获准远程工作。此次通知针对部分岗位，并非面向全公司的新制度。公司正在推进「One Disney」协作方式，希望不同业务团队使用更统一的工作流程。

item.title: 第一财经调查：AI 短剧「融合脸」增加肖像侵权举证难度
item.guid: 第一财经调查：AI-短剧「融合脸」增加肖像侵权举证难度
item.description:
A survey released by Yicai on September 15 showed that some AI simulated human short drama producers use 'real person base', 'fusion face' and 'padding images' to mix facial features from multiple faces, or modify skin tone, age, and contours on real person base images. These images are somewhere between 'like' and 'unlike', making it harder for ordinary people to prove that AI characters used their likeness. 第一财经 9 月 15 日发布的调查显示，一些 AI 仿真人短剧制作方使用「真人打底」、「融合脸」和「垫图」，将多张人脸的五官特征混合，或在真人底图上修改肤色、年龄和轮廓。这类图像介于「像」与「不像」之间，让普通人更难证明 AI 角色使用了自己的肖像。

The core standard for courts to determine portrait rights infringement is 'recognizability'. Lawyers interviewed pointed out that when facial features are mixed and deeply modified, victims often lack sufficient image samples and technical appraisal support; even if the lawsuit is successful, compensation may only cover notarization, legal, and lost income costs. 法院认定肖像权侵权的核心标准是「可识别性」。受访律师指出，当脸部特征被混合和深度修改后，受害者往往缺少足够的影像样本与技术鉴定支持；即使诉讼成功，赔偿也可能只能覆盖公证、律师和误工成本。

The survey also found that some leading models already intercept generation requests that are too close to real people, but producers can bypass filtering by using overseas services or self-deployed open-source models. For infringing content that has already been listed, platforms currently mostly remove it after receiving complaints. 调查还发现，部分头部模型已会拦截过于接近真人的生成请求，但制作方可借助境外服务或自行部署的开源模型绕开过滤。对已上架的侵权内容，平台当前多在收到投诉后下架处理。

item.title: Waymo 计划 2027 年在东京推出全无人出租车
item.guid: Waymo-计划-2027-年在东京推出全无人出租车
item.description:
Waymo, Japan's transportation and mobility platform GO, announced a strategic partnership on September 15, planning to launch Level 4 fully autonomous taxi services in Tokyo in 2027. According to the Japanese announcement, this will be Japan's first fully autonomous commercial taxi project. Waymo、日本交通与出行平台 GO 9 月 15 日宣布达成战略合作，计划于 2027 年在东京推出 Level 4 全无人出租车服务。按日方公告的目标，这将是日本首个全无人商业出租车项目。

The three companies will conduct road tests in seven districts of Tokyo starting in 2025, supervised by trained Japanese transportation drivers inside the vehicles, to help Waymo Driver adapt to local road environments such as narrow streets and densely populated areas. After commercialization, passengers will be able to hail rides through the GO or Waymo apps, with services planned to operate 24 hours a day. 三家公司自 2025 年起在东京 7 个区开展公路测试，由受训练的日本交通司机在车内监督，帮助 Waymo Driver 适应窄路、人群密集路段等本地道路环境。商业化后，乘客将可通过 GO 或 Waymo 应用叫车，服务计划 24 小时运行。

item.title: 曝 OpenAI 雇佣数百名外包人员审阅 ChatGPT 对话
item.guid: 曝-OpenAI-雇佣数百名外包人员审阅-ChatGPT-对话
item.description:
According to 404 Media, based on internal documents and actual prompts, OpenAI is using a project codenamed 'Project Lily' to have hundreds of outsourced personnel review real ChatGPT user prompts, with some tasks presenting complete conversations. Reviewers are required to score and comment on model responses to improve response quality, including reducing sycophantic tendencies and anthropomorphic expressions of the model. 据 404 Media 根据内部文件和实际提示词报道，OpenAI 正通过代号为「Project Lily」的项目，让数百名外包人员审阅 ChatGPT 用户的真实提示词，部分任务会呈现完整对话。审阅员需对模型回复进行打分和评论，用于改进回复质量，包括减少谄媚倾向和对模型的拟人化表述。

These materials do not display ChatGPT usernames to reviewers. OpenAI stated that conversations are processed by a Privacy Filter before being sent for review, but sensitive personal information may still leak through the filter. Anthropic also confirmed to 404 Media that it uses human review to improve its models. 这些材料不向审阅员显示 ChatGPT 用户名。OpenAI 表示，对话在送往审阅前会经过 Privacy Filter 处理，但敏感个人信息仍可能漏过过滤。Anthropic 也向 404 Media 确认，其会使用人工审阅来改进模型。

OpenAI's data control statement shows that conversations from personal versions of ChatGPT and Codex can be used to improve the model; users can turn off 'Improve model for all users' in 'Data Controls' under 'Settings', after which new conversations will no longer be used for training. OpenAI 的数据控制说明显示，个人版 ChatGPT 和 Codex 的对话可用于改进模型；用户可在「设置」的「数据控制」中关闭「为所有用户改进模型」，之后的新对话将不再用于训练。

item.title: 环球音乐起诉 DistroKid，指控其放任 AI 音乐与侵权录音涌入平台
item.guid: 环球音乐起诉-DistroKid，指控其放任-AI-音乐与侵权录音涌入平台
item.description:
Universal Music Group and its subsidiary Capitol Records sued DistroKid in U.S. Federal Court in Delaware on September 15, accusing the music distributor of engaging in deceptive business practices and continuously distributing infringing recordings. 环球音乐集团与旗下 Capitol Records 9 月 15 日在美国特拉华联邦法院起诉 DistroKid，指控这家音乐分发商实施欺骗性商业行为并持续分发侵权录音。

The lawsuit distinguishes between 'clearly labeled AI-generated music' and content that impersonates works by real musicians. Universal Music claims that DistroKid misled streaming platforms into believing that its distributed content was created and owned by real musicians, and continued to send the same content to other services even after admitting it had no right to distribute certain recordings. 诉状把「明确标注的 AI 生成音乐」与冒充真人音乐人作品的内容区分开来。环球音乐称，DistroKid 让流媒体平台误以为其分发内容由真实音乐人创作并持有权利，同时在已经承认无权分发部分录音后，仍将相同内容送往其他服务。

Universal Music listed 1,000 specific recordings and stated that this is only part of the overall problem. DistroKid claims to distribute content for over 4 million musicians, accounting for approximately 40% of new music released globally; the lawsuit will lead to further scrutiny of the boundaries of responsibility for music distribution platforms regarding AI content labeling, copyright verification, and anti-fraud measures. 环球音乐列举了 1000 首具体录音，并称这只是全部问题的一部分。DistroKid 自称为超过 400 万名音乐人分发内容，约占全球新发行音乐的 40%；诉讼将让音乐分发平台对 AI 内容标注、版权核验和反刷量的责任边界受到进一步审视。

item.title: Cornelis 完成 2.05 亿美元融资，推出可边计算边传输的 AI 网络
item.guid: Cornelis-完成-2.05-亿美元融资，推出可边计算边传输的-AI-网络
item.description:
AI networking company Cornelis announced on September 14 that it has completed a $205 million funding round led by IAG Capital Partners. The company also launched Active Compute Fabric, aiming to reduce GPU idle time caused by waiting for data transfer. AI 网络公司 Cornelis 9 月 14 日宣布完成 2.05 亿美元融资，由 IAG Capital Partners 领投。公司同时推出 Active Compute Fabric，试图减少 GPU 等待数据传输时产生的空转。

According to TechCrunch, this network allows chips to send information while processing data and uses an open architecture that can be paired with GPUs and accelerators from different manufacturers. Cornelis spun off from Intel in 2020, its current products have begun shipping, and next-generation products are planned for release later this year. 据 TechCrunch 报道，这套网络允许芯片在处理数据的同时发送信息，并采用开放架构，可搭配不同厂商的 GPU 和加速器。Cornelis 于 2020 年从 Intel 分拆，现有产品已经开始出货，下一代产品计划于今年晚些时候推出。

item.title: Altera 已秘密提交美国 IPO 申请，拟募资超过 20 亿美元
item.guid: Altera-已秘密提交美国-IPO-申请，拟募资超过-20-亿美元
item.description:
Altera confirmed on September 15 that it has confidentially filed for an initial public offering in the U.S. Reuters previously reported that the chip company, owned by Silver Lake and Intel, could complete its listing as early as this year, potentially raising over $2 billion. Altera 9 月 15 日确认，已秘密提交美国首次公开募股申请。路透社此前报道称，这家由 Silver Lake 和英特尔持股的芯片公司最快可能在今年完成上市，募资规模或超过 20 亿美元。

Altera produces programmable chips used in data centers, communication networks, industrial equipment, AI, aerospace, and defense systems. Silver Lake holds a 51% stake in the company, with Intel retaining 49%. Under the confidential filing mechanism, the company can disclose financial materials closer to its listing. Altera 生产用于数据中心、通信网络、工业设备、AI、航空航天与国防系统的可编程芯片。Silver Lake 持有公司 51% 股份，英特尔保留 49%。根据秘密提交机制，公司可以在临近上市时再公开财务材料。

item.title: Factory 完成 2 亿美元融资，估值升至 50 亿美元
item.guid: Factory-完成-2-亿美元融资，估值升至-50-亿美元
item.description:
AI programming agent company Factory announced on September 15 that it has completed a $200 million funding round, valuing the company at $5 billion post-investment. Blackstone, Khosla Ventures, Sequoia Capital, Insight Partners, and other institutions participated, bringing the company's total funding to over $400 million. AI 编程 Agent 公司 Factory 9 月 15 日宣布完成 2 亿美元融资，投后估值为 50 亿美元。Blackstone、Khosla Ventures、红杉资本、Insight Partners 等机构参与，公司累计融资额已超过 4 亿美元。

Factory stated that the new funds will be used for research, product development, and global market expansion. Its products are aimed at enterprise software development teams, can be deployed in cloud, on-premise, or fully isolated environments, and allow enterprises to control which models the system uses, how it learns, and where it runs. Factory 表示，新资金将用于研究、产品和全球市场扩张。其产品面向企业软件开发团队，可在云端、本地或完全隔离的环境中部署，并允许企业控制系统使用哪些模型、如何学习以及在哪里运行。

The company stated that clients such as Nvidia, Adobe, T-Mobile, and Royal Bank of Canada are currently using its platform. Factory also launched Router this year, which automatically selects models based on tasks, and claims that this feature can reduce token costs by over 60% while maintaining performance. 公司称，目前已有英伟达、Adobe、T-Mobile、加拿大皇家银行等客户使用其平台。Factory 今年还推出了按任务自动选择模型的 Router，并称该功能在维持性能的同时可将 token 成本降低超过 60%。

item.title: 💡 朱啸虎：办公 Agent 的竞争会延续协同办公平台格局
item.guid: 💡-朱啸虎：办公-Agent-的竞争会延续协同办公平台格局
item.description:
Zhu Xiaohu of GSR Ventures, in an interview with 'Shenwang', judged that office agents are more likely to be dominated by large companies. He believes that platforms like WeChat Work, Feishu, and DingTalk already control organizational relationships, historical chats, and enterprise knowledge bases, and this context will become the underlying barrier for office agents; opportunities for startups are more likely to appear in sufficiently deep vertical areas that platforms are unwilling or unable to cover themselves. 金沙江创投朱啸虎在《深网》的访谈中判断，办公 Agent 更有可能由大厂主导。他认为，企业微信、飞书和钉钉等平台已经掌握组织关系、历史聊天与企业知识库，这些上下文会成为办公 Agent 的底层壁垒；创业公司的机会更可能出现在足够深、平台不愿或无法自行覆盖的垂直领域。

Zhu Xiaohu also believes that foundational model capabilities are converging, and models will eventually be commoditized like public utilities. Competition at the application layer will return to entry points, customer acquisition, data accumulation, and ecosystem collaboration. He advises investors to distinguish between industry demand and valuation bubbles of individual companies using revenue growth, recurring revenue quality, and cash payback period. 朱啸虎同时认为，基础模型能力正在收敛，模型最终会像公共事业一样商品化，应用层的竞争将回到入口、获客、数据沉淀和生态协同。他建议投资者用收入增速、经常性收入质量和现金回报周期区分产业需求与个别公司的估值泡沫。

He believes that while the demand for programming Agents is clear, API customers can quickly switch to models with similar effects and lower costs, so revenue sustainability is more important than short-term growth. For application-layer entrepreneurs, he places more emphasis on execution speed, growth curves, and the product's ability to accumulate user-specific data. 他认为，编程 Agent 的需求虽然明确，但 API 客户可以迅速切换到效果相近、成本更低的模型，因此收入的可持续性要比短期增速更重要。对应用层创业者，他更看重执行速度、增长曲线和产品对用户专有数据的沉淀能力。

Regarding humanoid robots, he believes that the current number of companies is large, differences are small, and the proportion of real commercial orders is still low; future winners may rely more on supply chain, channels, and brand, rather than just early technological leadership. 对人形机器人，他认为当前企业数量多、差异小，真实商业订单比例仍低；未来的胜出者可能更依赖供应链、渠道和品牌，而不只是早期技术领先。

item.title: 小米 18 Pro 系列官宣本月发布，将升级背屏功能
item.guid: 小米-18-Pro-系列官宣本月发布，将升级背屏功能
item.description:
Lu Weibing, President of Xiaomi Group, announced on September 15 that the Xiaomi 18 Pro series will be released this month, and pre-heating for the new "Versatile Rear Screen" has begun. He stated that the new phone will upgrade in performance, imaging, battery life, and AI, and the core message of this pre-heating round is the rear screen solution. 小米集团总裁卢伟冰 9 月 15 日宣布，小米 18 Pro 系列将于本月发布，并开始预热全新「百变背屏」。他表示，新机将在性能、影像、续航和 AI 方面升级，本轮预热的核心信息是背屏方案。

Lu Weibing revealed that the previous generation's "Wonderful Rear Screen" called application cards more than 4 million times daily, and the number of rear screen wallpapers added daily exceeded 3.5 million. Xiaomi will adopt a more advanced solution this year and continue to announce rear screen features. 卢伟冰披露，上代「妙享背屏」每日调用应用卡片超过 400 万次，背屏壁纸单日添加量超过 350 万张。小米将在今年改用更先进的方案，并继续公布背屏功能。

item.title: 腾势 N8L 的「迪迪虾」接入支付宝，可用语音完成点单与停车缴费
item.guid: 腾势-N8L-的「迪迪虾」接入支付宝，可用语音完成点单与停车缴费
item.description:
Alipay announced on September 15 that its AI agent "Abao" has been integrated into BYD's super agent "Didi Xia". Denza N8L car owners can use voice commands in the car to initiate actions like buying coffee, paying parking fees, or claiming peripheral discount coupons. Didi Xia will understand the request, then hand it over to Abao to match the service and complete the preliminary process. 支付宝 9 月 15 日宣布，其 AI 智能体「阿宝」已接入比亚迪超级智能体「迪迪虾」。腾势 N8L 车主可在车内用语音发起买咖啡、缴停车费或领周边优惠券等指令，由迪迪虾理解需求，再交给阿宝匹配服务并完成前置流程。

Transactions still require users to verify information and authorize through manual confirmation or voiceprint verification. Both parties stated that Didi Xia does not possess users' Alipay account and financial information, nor does Abao operate the car's system or unrelated third-party applications. 交易仍需用户核对信息，并通过手动确认或声纹核身授权。双方表示，迪迪虾不掌握用户的支付宝账号与资金信息，阿宝也不操作车机及无关第三方应用。

Didi Xia first debuted on the Denza N8L pure electric version launched on September 14, and is compatible with A2A, MCP, and other protocols; in addition to Alipay, the first batch of ecosystem partners also includes NetEase Cloud Music, VolcEngine, and smart home service providers. 迪迪虾首搭于 9 月 14 日上市的腾势 N8L 纯电版，并兼容 A2A、MCP 等协议；除支付宝外，首批生态伙伴还包括网易云音乐、火山引擎和智能家居服务商。

item.title: 微信开源企业知识库 WeKnora，支持飞书、企微等接入
item.guid: 微信开源企业知识库-WeKnora，支持飞书、企微等接入
item.description:
The WeChat team open-sourced the enterprise-level knowledge base framework WeKnora, positioned as a knowledge management tool based on large language models, which can convert various internal enterprise data into a retrievable and inferable Agentic knowledge base. 微信团队开源了企业级知识库框架 WeKnora，定位为基于大语言模型的知识管理工具，可将企业内部的各类资料转换为可检索、可推理的 Agentic 知识库。

WeKnora supports multiple file formats such as PDF, Word, Excel, and images. It can also synchronize data sources like Feishu, Notion, GitLab, and Yuque, and integrate with chat tools such as WeChat Work, Feishu, and Slack, making it convenient to directly call knowledge base content in daily work scenarios. WeKnora 支持 PDF、Word、Excel、图片等多种文件格式，同时可同步飞书、Notion、GitLab、语雀等数据源，并接入企业微信、飞书、Slack 等聊天工具，方便直接在日常工作场景中调用知识库内容。

In terms of features, WeKnora primarily revolves around three parts: RAG knowledge Q&A, Agent intelligent entities, and automatic Wiki. Among them, RAG can retrieve relevant content from materials, answer questions, and provide sources; Agent can repeatedly consult materials and execute complex tasks by combining internet search, MCP, Skills, and other tools; automatic Wiki can extract information such as people, products, and concepts from a large amount of data, further organizing it into interconnected Wiki pages and knowledge graphs. 功能方面，WeKnora 主要围绕 RAG 知识问答、Agent 智能体和自动 Wiki 三部分展开。其中，RAG 可从资料中检索相关内容、回答问题并提供来源；Agent 能反复查阅资料，并结合联网搜索、MCP、Skills 等工具执行复杂任务；自动 Wiki 则可以从大量资料中提取人物、产品、概念等信息，进一步整理为相互关联的 Wiki 页面和知识图谱。

Regarding models, WeKnora supports OpenAI, DeepSeek, Qwen, Zhipu, Hunyuan, Gemini, MiniMax, Ollama, etc., and also supports self-deployment. The project is currently open-source on GitHub, adopting the MIT license. 模型方面，WeKnora 支持 OpenAI、DeepSeek、Qwen、智谱、混元、Gemini、MiniMax、Ollama 等，也支持自行部署。目前项目已经在 GitHub 开源，采用 MIT 协议。

item.title: 拓竹将发布首款激光雕刻切割机 R1
item.guid: 拓竹将发布首款激光雕刻切割机-R1
item.description:
Bambu Lab announced that it will release R1 at 22:00 on September 22, its first laser engraving and cutting product. Bambu Lab is thus expanding its personal manufacturing tool line from 3D printing to laser processing. 拓竹宣布，将于 9 月 22 日 22:00 发布 R1，这是该公司首款激光雕刻和切割产品。拓竹因此将个人制造工具线从 3D 打印拓展到激光加工。

When Bambu Lab first teased R1 in August, it positioned it as a new tool capable of processing more materials. The company previously offered 10W and 40W laser modules for its H2 series printers, while R1 is being released as a standalone laser engraving and cutting product. 拓竹 8 月首次预告 R1 时，将它定位为可处理更多材料的新工具。公司此前提供用于 H2 系列打印机的 10W 和 40W 激光模组，R1 则作为独立的激光雕刻切割产品发布。

item.title: 飞书发布 8.0 与「豆包工作伙伴」，Agent 可直接操作文档、日程与审批
item.guid: 飞书发布-8.0-与「豆包工作伙伴」，Agent-可直接操作文档、日程与审批
item.description:
On September 15, Feishu released version 8.0, opening up data and tool capabilities to Agents. Users can add Agents to group chats, and Agents can also edit documents, operate multi-dimensional tables, schedule events and to-dos, participate in meetings, access cloud drives and Mianotes, and initiate approvals within Feishu. 9 月 15 日，飞书发布 8.0 版本，向 Agent 开放数据和工具能力。用户可以把 Agent 加入群聊，Agent 也能在飞书中编辑文档、操作多维表格、安排日程与待办、参与会议、查阅云盘和妙记，以及发起审批。

Feishu stated that Agent's data permissions are consistent with its users; administrators can uniformly manage Agents, trace usage, limit AI usage, and control high-consumption models and scenarios. 飞书表示，Agent 的数据权限与其使用者一致；管理员可统一管理 Agent、追溯使用情况、限制 AI 用量，并管控高消耗模型和场景。

The "Doubao Work Partner" released concurrently has independent identity, permissions, and memory, can join group chats, and can call Feishu and enterprise business systems within the authorized scope. The product is currently in a co-creation phase with enterprises and will gradually be opened to customers. 同期发布的「豆包工作伙伴」拥有独立身份、权限和记忆，可加入群聊并在授权范围内调用飞书与企业业务系统。该产品目前处于与企业定向共创阶段，将逐步向客户开放。

item.title: 联发科发布天玑 9600 Pro，首批支持 2nm、LPDDR6 与 UFS 5.0
item.guid: 联发科发布天玑-9600-Pro，首批支持-2nm、LPDDR6-与-UFS-5.0
item.description:
MediaTek released its flagship mobile chip, Dimensity 9600 Pro, on September 15. The chip adopts a 2nm process and a fourth-generation full large-core CPU, configured with two Arm C2-Ultra cores, three C2-Pro cores with 1MB L2 cache, and three C2-Pro cores with 512KB L2 cache. 联发科 9 月 15 日发布旗舰移动芯片天玑 9600 Pro。该芯片采用 2nm 制程和第四代全大核 CPU，配置两颗 Arm C2-Ultra、三颗配备 1MB 二级缓存的 C2-Pro，以及三颗配备 512KB 二级缓存的 C2-Pro。

The Dimensity 9600 Pro integrates NPU 1090 and low-power NPU 2.0: the former is responsible for generative AI and Agent tasks, while the latter provides an independent operating domain for background resident AI. MediaTek states that compared to the previous generation flagship chip, its single-core performance has increased by 17% and power consumption has decreased by 37%, while multi-core performance has increased by 15% and power consumption has decreased by 61%. 天玑 9600 Pro 集成 NPU 1090 与低功耗 NPU 2.0：前者负责生成式 AI 和 Agent 任务，后者为后台常驻 AI 提供独立运行域。联发科称，与上一代旗舰芯片相比，其单核性能提升 17%、功耗降低 37%，多核性能提升 15%、功耗降低 61%。

The chip also supports LPDDR6 and UFS 5.0 in its first batch, with an Arm Mali-G2 Ultra NX GPU, supporting up to 4K 240fps slow-motion video, H.266 hardware decoding, and Bluetooth 6.2. The OPPO Find X10 Pro Max and vivo X500 Pro series have announced their first adoption. 芯片还首批支持 LPDDR6 与 UFS 5.0，GPU 为 Arm Mali-G2 Ultra NX，最高支持 4K 240 帧慢动作视频、H.266 硬件解码和蓝牙 6.2。OPPO Find X10 Pro Max 与 vivo X500 Pro 系列已宣布首批搭载。

item.title: 阶跃星辰发布 StepAudio 3，五款模型覆盖实时对话、识别与音频生成
item.guid: 阶跃星辰发布-StepAudio-3，五款模型覆盖实时对话、识别与音频生成
item.description:
On September 15, Step Audio released the StepAudio 3 series, including five voice models: Realtime, ASR, TTS, Gen, and Music, which are now available on the Step Audio Open Platform. 9 月 15 日，阶跃星辰发布 StepAudio 3 系列，包括 Realtime、ASR、TTS、Gen 和 Music 五款语音模型，现已上线阶跃星辰开放平台。

Among them, StepAudio 3 Realtime supports native full-duplex dialogue, interruption handling, and parallel inference and speech generation; tool calls and long tasks can be executed asynchronously without blocking the current session. Jiecixingchen cited the Artificial Analysis ranking, stating that the model's comprehensive dialogue dynamic score is 98.9%, and its speech inference accuracy is 99.7%. 其中，StepAudio 3 Realtime 支持原生全双工对话、打断处理，以及推理与语音生成并行；工具调用和长任务可异步执行，不阻塞当前会话。阶跃星辰引用 Artificial Analysis 榜单称，该模型的对话动态综合得分为 98.9%，语音推理准确率为 99.7%。

StepAudio 3 ASR supports Chinese, English, dialects, mixed Chinese-English, long audio, and professional domain recognition, with a word error rate of 1.7% in the Artificial Analysis non-streaming speech recognition ranking. Gen can jointly generate human voices, sound effects, ambient sounds, and background music, while Music supports continued creation based on lyrics, a cappella, reference songs, and ABC notation. StepAudio 3 ASR 支持中英文、方言、中英混说、长音频及专业领域识别，在 Artificial Analysis 非流式语音识别榜单中的词错误率为 1.7%。Gen 可联合生成人声、音效、环境音和背景音乐，Music 则支持基于歌词、清唱、参考歌曲和 ABC 记谱法继续创作。

item.title: 智象未来发布视频模型 HD-V1，可生成 5～20 秒 1080p 音画内容
item.guid: 智象未来发布视频模型-HD-V1，可生成-5～20-秒-1080p-音画内容
item.description:
ZhiXiang Future released its native full-modal video model HiDream-O1-Video-1.0, or HD-V1 for short, on September 15th. The model supports text, image, and video input, can autonomously plan durations of 5-20 seconds based on content, and directly generates 1080p videos with sound. 智象未来 9 月 15 日发布原生全模态视频模型 HiDream-O1-Video-1.0，简称 HD-V1。模型支持文本、图片和视频输入，可根据内容自行规划 5～20 秒时长，并直接生成带声音的 1080p 视频。

Before generation, HD-V1 breaks down natural language requirements into shot duration, scene, characters, actions, composition, camera movement, dialogue, and sound design, then jointly models text, video, and audio. ZhiXiang Future states that this process is used to improve character consistency across shots, action continuity, physical feedback, and audio-visual synchronization. HD-V1 在生成前会把自然语言需求拆成镜头时长、场景、角色、动作、构图、运镜、台词与声音设计，再联合建模文本、视频和音频。智象未来表示，这套流程用于提高跨镜头的人物一致性、动作连续性、物理反馈和音画同步。

The company cited third-party rankings, stating that HD-V1 ranks 4th in Artificial Analysis's image-to-video with audio list and 8th in Arena.ai's image-to-video list. ZhiXiang Future also announced the completion of its C+ round of financing, with investors including Xinwei Capital, Jiaozi Capital, and ICBC Capital, though the financing amount was not disclosed. 公司引用第三方榜单称，HD-V1 在 Artificial Analysis 的带音频图生视频榜单排名第 4，在 Arena.ai 图生视频榜单排名第 8。智象未来同期宣布完成 C+ 轮融资，投资方包括新微资本、交子资本和工银资本，未披露融资金额。

item.title: DeepSeek Harness 0.1.6 增加 Browser Use 与 Computer Use
item.guid: DeepSeek-Harness-0.1.6-增加-Browser-Use-与-Computer-Use
item.description:
DeepSeek released DeepSeek Harness v0.1.6-alpha.1 on September 15th, with the new version adding experimental Browser Use and Computer Use. The former offers three browser backends: Playwright MCP, Chrome DevTools MCP, and Stagehand; the latter can operate the local machine and capture screenshots via Cua Driver MCP or native drivers. DeepSeek 9 月 15 日发布 DeepSeek Harness v0.1.6-alpha.1，新版加入实验性 Browser Use 和 Computer Use。前者提供 Playwright MCP、Chrome DevTools MCP 和 Stagehand 三种浏览器后端；后者可通过 Cua Driver MCP 或原生驱动操作本机并获取截图。

This version also adds a recoverable multi-tab terminal to the Web sidebar and enables Headless mode to support receiving tasks from standard input, resuming sessions with `–session-id`, and outputting line-by-line JSON runtime events with `–json`. MCP has also been upgraded to the official SDK v2, supporting protocol negotiation, tool pagination, resource reading, and URI templates. 该版本还为 Web 侧边栏增加可恢复的多标签终端，并让 Headless 模式支持从标准输入接收任务、用 `–session-id` 续接会话，以及用 `–json` 输出逐行 JSON 运行事件。MCP 也升级至官方 SDK v2，支持协议协商、工具分页、资源读取和 URI 模板。

This is still an alpha preview for developers, with the official documentation clearly marking Browser Use, Computer Use, and Auto review as experimental. 此次仍是面向开发者的 alpha 预览版，官方明确标注了 Browser Use、Computer Use 和 Auto review 的实验性质。

item.title: 罗永浩差评带来意外流量，野人先生单日涨粉近 3 万
item.guid: 罗永浩差评带来意外流量，野人先生单日涨粉近-3-万
item.description:
On September 12th, Luo Yonghao commented on social media that Mr. Savage Gelato was 'very ordinary' and believed its pricing didn't match its taste. After the content spread, many netizens flocked to the brand's account comment section, advising against public confrontation, and the related discussions actually brought nearly 30,000 new followers to the brand. 罗永浩 9 月 12 日在社交平台评价野人先生 Gelato「很一般」，并认为其定价与口味不匹配。内容扩散后，不少网友涌入品牌账号评论区劝其不要公开对质，相关讨论反而为品牌带来近 3 万名新增粉丝。

Mr. Savage's video account gained over 400,000 followers in the past 30 days. After opening for franchising in 2024, the brand accelerated its expansion, now boasting over 1,700 stores nationwide and having entered the Hong Kong and Singapore markets, with single-scoop products typically priced between 28 and 38 yuan. 野人先生视频账号近 30 天累计涨粉超过 40 万。该品牌 2024 年开放加盟后加快扩张，目前全国门店超过 1700 家，并已进入香港和新加坡市场，单球产品价格多在 28～38 元。

The brand emphasizes freshly made on the day, low-fat, low-sugar, and unique flavors like rice and pistachio. Previously, some consumers questioned its pricing and 'handmade' claims; the brand's representative responded in January this year, stating that the price comprehensively considers ingredients, craftsmanship, and portion size, and taste experience is subject to strong personal preference. 品牌主打当日现做、低脂低糖和大米、开心果等特色口味。此前也有消费者质疑其定价和「手工现制」宣传；品牌负责人今年 1 月回应称，价格综合考虑了原料、工艺与分量，口味体验存在较强的个人偏好。

item.title: 两部门要求美团、携程等平台自查「全网最低价」风险
item.guid: 两部门要求美团、携程等平台自查「全网最低价」风险
item.description:
On September 15th, the State Administration for Market Regulation, in conjunction with the Ministry of Culture and Tourism, convened an administrative guidance meeting for the online hotel booking platform service industry. Representatives from platforms such as Meituan, Douyin, JD.com, Ctrip, Tongcheng, and Fliggy, as well as market supervision department heads from Beijing, Shanghai, Jiangsu, and Zhejiang, attended the meeting. 9 月 15 日，市场监管总局会同文化和旅游部召开在线酒店预订平台服务行业行政指导会。美团、抖音、京东、携程、同程、飞猪等平台负责人，以及北京、上海、江苏、浙江等地市场监管部门负责人参会。

The meeting required platforms to comply with the Anti-Monopoly Law, Anti-Unfair Competition Law, E-commerce Law, and Tourism Law, to self-inspect competitive risks such as exclusive cooperation and 'lowest price across the network' against case examples, and to establish long-term compliance mechanisms. 会议要求平台遵守反垄断法、反不正当竞争法、电子商务法和旅游法，对照案例自查独家合作、「全网最低价」等竞争风险，健全长期合规机制。

Regulatory authorities pointed to issues concerning hotel operators' independent pricing and cross-platform operating environment, and required platforms to safeguard consumer rights and maintain a market order of quality and fair pricing. This meeting was an administrative guidance, and the official announcement did not disclose penalties or deadlines for rectification. 监管部门将问题指向酒店经营者的自主定价与跨平台经营环境，并要求平台维护消费者权益及优质优价的市场秩序。此次会议属于行政指导，官方通报没有公布处罚或整改期限。

item.title: 小红书发布首份金融生态公约，禁止非法荐股与「保本保息」承诺
item.guid: 小红书发布首份金融生态公约，禁止非法荐股与「保本保息」承诺
item.description:
On September 15th, Xiaohongshu released its first 'Community Financial Ecosystem Convention,' explicitly prohibiting eight types of content, including malicious bearish commentary, illegal stock recommendations, illegal financial activities, fabricating authoritative endorsements, promising 'principal and interest guaranteed,' creating fake investor personas, and covertly diverting traffic off-platform. 9 月 15 日，小红书发布首份《社区金融生态公约》，明确禁止恶意唱衰、非法荐股、非法金融活动、伪造权威背书、承诺「保本保息」、编造虚假投资人设和变相导流站外等八类内容。

Xiaohongshu's head of commercial finance disclosed that over the past year, the platform's financial content averaged nearly 2 million posts and approximately 12 million comments per month; among monthly active financial users, 75% engaged in search behavior, with financial product-related search terms growing by over 110% year-on-year. 小红书商业金融行业负责人披露，过去一年，平台金融相关内容月均发布量接近 200 万篇、月均评论约 1200 万条；金融月活用户中，75% 有搜索行为，金融产品相关搜索词同比增长超过 110%。

After launching a special governance initiative for the financial ecosystem earlier this year, Xiaohongshu has processed over 1.01 million non-compliant posts, more than 157,000 non-compliant accounts, and over 4.77 million non-compliant comments in the past six months, addressing issues such as illegal stock recommendations, falsified qualifications, illegal cross-border investment traffic diversion, and non-compliant insurance marketing. 今年初启动金融生态专项治理后，小红书在近半年处置违规笔记超过 101 万篇、违规账号 15.7 万余个、违规评论超过 477 万条，涉及非法荐股、伪造资质、非法跨境投资导流和违规保险营销等问题。

item.title: Apple TV 续订《流人》第八季，改编《Clown Town》
item.guid: Apple-TV-续订《流人》第八季，改编《Clown-Town》
item.description:
Apple TV announced on September 15th that it has renewed 'Slow Horses' for an eighth season. The new season will consist of 6 episodes, adapted from Mick Herron's ninth 'Slough House' novel, 'Clown Town,' with Gary Oldman continuing to star as Jackson Lamb. Apple TV 9 月 15 日宣布续订《流人》第八季。新一季共 6 集，改编自 Mick Herron「Slough House」系列第九部小说《Clown Town》，Gary Oldman 将继续饰演 Jackson Lamb。

The eighth season will revolve around a direct confrontation between Jackson Lamb and Diana Taverner. Ben Vanstone is responsible for the series adaptation and executive production, and Adam Randall returns to direct. The sixth season of the show will premiere on September 16th, and the seventh season was renewed last year. 第八季将围绕 Jackson Lamb 与 Diana Taverner 的正面冲突展开，Ben Vanstone 负责剧集改编与执行制片，Adam Randall 回归执导。该剧第六季将于 9 月 16 日开播，第七季已于去年获续订。

item.title: Netflix 新版《傲慢与偏见》定档 12 月 3 日上线
item.guid: Netflix-新版《傲慢与偏见》定档-12-月-3-日上线
item.description:
Netflix announced on September 15th that a new limited series adaptation of 'Pride and Prejudice' will premiere on December 3rd, consisting of 6 episodes. Screenwriter Dolly Alderton stated that the series will closely adhere to Jane Austen's original 1813 novel while making some new adjustments to characters and expression. Netflix 9 月 15 日宣布，新版《傲慢与偏见》限定剧将于 12 月 3 日上线，共 6 集。编剧 Dolly Alderton 表示，剧集将贴近简·奥斯汀 1813 年的原著，同时在人物与表达上作出部分新调整。

Emma Corrin plays Elizabeth Bennet, Jack Lowden plays Darcy, and Olivia Colman and Rufus Sewell play Mr. and Mrs. Bennet, respectively. The series is directed by Euros Lyn, director of "Heartstopper," with Alderton, Lyn, Corrin, and others serving as executive producers. Emma Corrin 饰演伊丽莎白·班纳特，Jack Lowden 饰演达西，Olivia Colman 与 Rufus Sewell 分别饰演班纳特夫妇。剧集由《心跳漏一拍》导演 Euros Lyn 执导，Alderton、Lyn 与 Corrin 等人担任执行制片。

Netflix also released the first batch of stills for 11 main characters. Freya Mavor plays Jane Bennet, Daryl McCormack plays Bingley, and Louis Partridge plays Wickham; this is also one of the platform's key classic literature adaptation projects launched this year. Netflix 同步公布了 11 名主要角色的首批剧照。Freya Mavor 饰演简·班纳特，Daryl McCormack 饰演宾利，Louis Partridge 饰演威克姆；这也是该平台今年重点推出的经典文学改编项目之一。
